title: finding(i18n): the objectui#10024 / #10242 `=== 1` plural defect on seven more keys (eight values) in `ru` / `ar`: the reaction chip, presence avatars, list and lookup record counts, revision field count and search items available
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites, read at source. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the execution seat that claims it. The sites are values in `packages/i18n/src/locales/ru.ts` and `ar.ts`, each behind a verified `=== 1` two-key switch.

Filed by the `domain:ui#4` execution seat (`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10242 (PR objectui#10415, class a), as the seat's surface amendment `5824097794` planned. The contract re-review of that PR spot-checked every value below at its head. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

This is the same mechanism as objectui#10024 and objectui#10242. A consumer picks its `…One` key at exactly one and the plain key at every other count. The plain key holds a single noun form, which is wrong at some of the counts it serves: `ru` at 2–4 (`few`) and 21 (`one`), and `ar` at 2 (`two`) and from 11 up (`many`, `other`). objectui#10242 fixed five values with the objectui#10024 count-label device. These eight values sit behind the same switch, are outside that card's key list, and are unchanged on `main`.

In this table the i18next placeholders are spelled COUNT and EMOJI; the tree uses the double-brace form.

| key | pack | value on `main` | switch (consumer) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `detail.reactionCount` | ar | `EMOJI COUNT تفاعلات` | `reaction.count === 1` (`ReactionPicker`) |
| `collaboration.presentUserCount` | ar | `COUNT مستخدمين متواجدين` | `users.length === 1` (`PresenceAvatars`) |
| `collaboration.moreUserCount` | ar | `COUNT مستخدمين آخرين` | `overflowCount === 1` (`PresenceAvatars`) |
| `list.recordCount` | ru | `COUNT записей` | `totalCount === 1` (`ListView`) |
| `list.recordCount` | ar | `COUNT سجلات` | `totalCount === 1` (`ListView`) |
| `lookup.recordCount` | ar | `COUNT سجل` | `totalCount === 1` (`RecordPickerDialog`) |
| `detail.revisionFieldsChanged` | ar | `تم تغيير COUNT حقول` | `revision.changes.length === 1` (`PointInTimeRestore`) |
| `search.itemsAvailable` | ar | `COUNT عناصر متاحة` | `allItems.length === 1` (`SearchResultsPage`) |

The `ru` values of `lookup.recordCount` and `detail.revisionFieldsChanged` are already count labels, so only `ar` is listed for those keys.

## Reproduction

The values and switches were read at source by the objectui#10242 dev and its reviewer. ⛔ Not probed here. objectui#10415's pin (`packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/countLabels.ruAr-10242.test.tsx`) is the model: a real i18next from `createI18n`, each consumer rendered for real, and the representative counts from `Intl.PluralRules` (`ru` 2, 5, 21; `ar` 2, 3, 11).

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The fix shape is known and ruled for this family: the objectui#10024 / #10240 / #10242 count label (a label, a colon, then the number). ⛔ No `_few` / `_two` key: `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` holds every pack to `en`'s key set.
- `ar` `search.itemsAvailable` is also pinned in `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/searchItemsAvailable-plural-9664.test.ts`, and the pending `.changeset/9664-search-items-available-plural.md` ends with a sentence about the noun pair `ar` shares with `common.itemCount`. objectui#10415's review judged that sentence loosened, not false. If it is still pending when this card lands, retire or reword it here.
- `ar` `detail.reactionCount` is the Arabic half of the reaction chip that objectui#10415 fixed for `ru` only.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items. The pattern `presentUserCount`, `moreUserCount`, `revisionFieldsChanged`, `lookup.recordCount`, `list.recordCount`, or `detail.reactionCount` near `ar` ⇒ 2 hits: objectui#10242 (the source card, whose five keys are fixed by objectui#10415; ⛔ not these) and objectui#3880 (closed; a shared-en-string translation census, unrelated). The control `itemsAvailable` ⇒ 3 hits (objectui#10024, #10025, #9664), so the instrument is lit.

Dedupe words: `presentUserCount ar dual` · `list.recordCount ru few` · `ar detail.reactionCount تفاعلات` · `lookup.recordCount ar singular` · `revisionFieldsChanged ar` · `=== 1 two-key plural sibling keys`
